column1: # The standard corpora the Benchmark tab offers, in picker order. Columns:
#   1 id <TAB> 2 title <TAB> 3 language tag <TAB> 4 manifest, relative to Application Support/Speech/Corpora <TAB> 5 recordings in the full set
#   6 archive bytes to download <TAB> 7 bytes on disk once unpacked <TAB> 8 speech's fetch tool <TAB> 9 its argument
#   10 the archive while it downloads, relative to the Corpora directory <TAB> 11 where it comes from and its license
# The id is the corpus column of speech's published measurements (docs/benchmarks/measurements.tsv), and the manifest path is where
# speech's tools/fetch-fleurs.sh and tools/fetch-librispeech.sh put a corpus when SPEECH_CORPUS_DIR is that Corpora directory.
